GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf.title: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf.reason: No patched release exists: the advisory covers <=4.0.7 and 4.0.7 is the latest published version. It is reached only through @parcel/watcher, an optional file-watch dependency of sass (itself pulled in by @excalidraw/excalidraw), which the shipped bundle never executes.
